Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.constants

Class RealControllerConstants.HardLimits.HardLimit

java.lang.Object
frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.constants.RealControllerConstants.HardLimits.HardLimit
Enclosing class:
RealControllerConstants.HardLimits
public static class RealControllerConstants.HardLimits.HardLimit extends Object
The configuration for one hard limit switch - either a real switch wired to a DigitalInput, or a "virtual" one inferred from motor stall current. See Controller.getLimit(int) and Controller.periodic().

  • Field Details

    • id

      public int id
      ID of limit switch used in the subsystem.

    • isVirtual

      public boolean isVirtual
      Whether to use a virtual limit switch (according to the current the motor takes) instead of a real one.

    • virtualStallThreshold

      public double virtualStallThreshold
      How much current is needed to activate the virtual limit to behave like a real limit switch

    • minPos

      public double minPos
      The minimum position of the encoder to apply the limit. If the encoder is under this value the limit will be ignored, so don't change this number for limits that reset the encoder

    • maxPos

      public double maxPos
      The maximum position of the encoder to apply the limit. If the encoder is above this value the limit will be ignored, so don't change this number for limits that reset the encoder

    • frames

      public double frames
      The amount of frames the limit needs to be turned on to count as clicked

    • inverted

      public boolean inverted
      Whether the limit switch is inverted.

    • direction

      public int direction
      the direction of movement in which the limit will be clicked, for example if an elevator goes down when given minus as output and the limit switch is at the bottom then this value should be -1.

    • enableLimitTriggerMethod

      public boolean enableLimitTriggerMethod
      Whether limitTriggerMethod should be invoked when this limit newly becomes active.

    • limitTriggerMethod

      public RealControllerConstants.HardLimits.LimitTriggerMethod limitTriggerMethod
      Called from Controller.periodic() when this limit newly becomes active (and enableLimitTriggerMethod is true). By default it resets the encoder to homePosition and, if the motor is still being driven into the limit, commands a position hold there - see RealControllerConstants.HardLimits.LimitTriggerMethod.

    • homePosition

      public double homePosition
      The home position of the subsystem where the limit switch is and is usually 0. when the limit switch is hit the encoder will reset to this value.
